meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Luxury Home!* Brand New Luxury Home in Seacrest Beach Neighborhood* Private Beach Access * Pet-Friendly (additional $200 fee)* 4 Bikes Included* Expansive Rooftop Deck – Outdoor Kitchen and Dining Area – Enjoy meals and drinks
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Luxury Home!* Brand New Luxury Home in Seacrest Beach Neighborhood* Private Beach Access * Pet-Friendly (additional $200 fee)* 4 Bikes Included* Expansive Rooftop Deck – Outdoor Kitchen and Dining Area – Enjoy meals and drinks while taking in the beautiful coastal surroundings* 12,000 Sq. Ft. Community Pool – Enjoy access to Seacrest Beach's famous resort-style pool* Close to Shops and Restaurants-Perfect Location Between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest so we can further assist!Welcome to Palms by the Sea, a beautifully designed luxury retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach, offering an incredible setup for families and large groups traveling together. When the main home and carriage house are rented together, guests enjoy 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and accommodations for up to 18 guests, giving everyone plenty of space to relax, gather, and enjoy their 30A getaway. The main home features four bedrooms, including two king master suites, a queen bedroom, and a fun second-floor bunk room with two Twin-over-Full bunk beds. The gourmet kitchen features quartz countertops and premium appliances. The rooftop deck is the perfect gathering spot, with an outdoor kitchen and dining area for family meals, evening cocktails, and beautiful Emerald Coast sunsets. The beautifully remodeled carriage house offers a king bed on the first floor, a queen bed upstairs, a brand-new bathroom, and a fully equipped kitchen, a private outdoor space with a bistro table and chairs, offering an ideal space for additional guests or family members. Spend your days relaxing by the pool, enjoying the nearby beach, and exploring everything Seacrest and 30A have to offer, then come together in the evening for dinner, drinks, and memories under the stars. With spacious accommodations, multiple gathering areas, private spaces, and a fantastic location, Palms by the Sea Main and Carriage House is the perfect choice for large families and groups looking to vacation together in comfort and style.The Bed Setup:1st FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedSecond-FloorBunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Full Bunk Beds3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedCarriage House:1st Floor Master: King Bed2nd Floor Guest Bedroom: Queen BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play, and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
